probes.expect: no crash (shown for discussion, not scored)
probes.answer:
# VPN Policy Summary

**When VPN is Required:**
The company VPN must be used whenever you access internal systems from any network that is not the office network, including home broadband and mobile hotspot. [1] Public Wi-Fi is allowed only with the VPN switched on. [2]

**VPN Certificates:**
Each laptop holds a VPN certificate valid for 365 days. You must renew your certificate from the self-service portal at least 14 days before it expires. An expired certificate prevents the VPN from connecting. [3]

**Session Limits:**
A VPN session stays connected for a maximum of 12 hours, after which you must sign in again with multi-factor authentication (MFA). Sessions idle for 60 minutes are also automatically disconnected. [4]

**Personal Devices:**
Personal devices may connect to the VPN only if the company endpoint agent is installed and reporting as healthy. Personal devices may never be used to store Confidential or Restricted data. [3]

**MFA Registration:**
If you change your phone, raise a ticket to reset your MFA registration before you travel. [4]
